heading: Welcome to Riverside
intro: You have arrived in a village on the edge of the Whispering Woods. Something is stirring beyond its gates, but the square is safe enough to get your bearings.

objectives.instruction: Read your surroundings and available exits
Speak with Elder Thorne to learn about the village's troubles
Equip your rusty dagger before venturing beyond town
Take the north road when you are ready to explore
